messages.subject: shiny / ggvis data issue
parts:
Okay, I have a dataset that I create based on a selectInput. I then remove NAs and this results in a different sized data set for each selectInput selection.

When I try to combine that with a linked brush, it doesn't work. I tried making the linked brush a reactive, and that didn't seem to work either.

I've created a example here... https://gist.github.com/corynissen/4fb922fd991df3d0219d

you can run it in shiny with:
library(shiny)
runGist("https://gist.github.com/corynissen/4fb922fd991df3d0219d")

If you comment out the "df <- df[-c(1:runif(1, 1, 10)),]" line, everything is cool, but that's the simulation of me removing NAs, so I need that in there.

Thanks

Cory

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: shiny / ggvis data issue
parts:
Hi Cory,

I think the problem is that linked_brush() doesn't quite support this
case yet - I didn't think that the original keys and the keys in the
plot might be different. I suspect the code should look something like
this:

df <- mtcars
df$id <- 1:nrow(df)

plot_data <- reactive({
df$x <- df[,input$x_var]
# do some dynamic change of the data...

df
})

selected_plot_data <- reactive({
df <- plot_data()
df$selected <- lb$selected(df$id)
df
})

lb <- linked_brush(keys = df$id, "red")

Hadley
